findings.summary: Second-prize resolution order (localization/design.md and menu-workspace/design.md give a three-step order menus/<L>/<name>.toml -> base menus/<name>.toml -> code-only DEFAULT_*_TOML) is a correct superset of Req 12.7's two-step wording ('locale file else Identity_Base'), but the mapping is left implicit.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the design noting that for a USER menu the 'Identity_Base definition' of Req 12.7 is the base menus/<name>.toml, and for a built-in it is the code-only DEFAULT_*_TOML, so the two-step requirement maps cleanly onto the three-step design.

findings.summary: The design says the two reconstruct seams re-read 'the THEN-active locale L each time' but does not name HOW L is obtained at reconstruct_settings_menu / reconstruct_named_menu.
findings.fix: Add a half-sentence naming the active-locale source the two seams read (the same ui.locale accessor on_locale_reload / menu_option_command_surfaces use).
